title: Newmark Arranges Sale of Wynwood Jungle, a Landmark Retail Destination in Miami's Wynwood Arts District
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the sale of Wynwood Jungle, a 38,946-square-foot retail property located in the heart of Miami's internationally recognized Wynwood Arts District.
